record.dic_text:
01090 Bilhah {bil-ha:'}

源自 01089;

欽定本 - Bilhah 11; 11

辟拉 = "麻煩的"
陰性專有名詞 人名
1) 拉結的使女, 給雅各為妾, 為雅各生了但, 拿弗他利

專有名詞 地名
2) 位於西緬地的一個城市 (#代上 4:29|)
record.edic_text:
01090 Bilhah {bil-haw'}

from 01089;;

AV - Bilhah 11; 11

Bilhah = "troubled"
n pr f
1) Rachel's handmaid whom she gave to Jacob as a concubine, mother to
   two of Jacob's children, Dan and Naphtali
n pr loc
2) a city in Simeon
